title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs: Discount Pricing Terms for Cash Fills
content:
Discount prices of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs apply to cash fills under these terms.

**(a) When a discount price applies.** A discount price is applied only while the enrollment is in active status, and only to a fill that is not billed to insurance. The status is read from the enrollment record before the price is applied.

**(b) Kestrel Value Generics.** Where the value list is available, a generic on the Kestrel Value Generics list is priced at the program's 30-day value price for up to 30 days, or at its 90-day value price for 31 days up to the program's largest value-list days supply.

**(c) Other generics and brands.** The clause "any other generic is priced at the usual and customary price less the generic discount percent, and a brand at the usual price less the brand discount percent, rounded to the cent half up" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**(d) Price limits.** The price is never below the program's minimum cash price and never above the usual price.

**(e) Specialty drugs.** Where the program excludes specialty drugs, a specialty prescription gets no discount.

**(f) Vaccines.** A cash vaccine is discounted by the program's vaccine discount percent under the Immunization Services rules.

**(g) Whose prescriptions.** The discount applies to prescriptions of the enrolling patient and, for a family membership, of the covered household members only.

**(h) Savings recorded.** The savings recorded on a discounted fill are the usual and customary price less the price the patient paid.

## Value-list bands (hypothetical fills, value list available, largest value-list supply 90 days)

| Days supply | Price band |
|---|---|
| 1 to 30 | 30-day value price |
| 31 to 90 | 90-day value price |

## Hypothetical savings figure

A fill with a usual and customary price of $40.00 sold at $10.00 records savings of $30.00.

superseded_clauses: Any other generic is priced at the usual and customary price less generic_discount_pct percent, and a brand at the usual price less brand_discount_pct percent, rounded to the cent half up.
